focus.title: 本周全球经贸主线：出口管制联盟化与关税工具化并行，供应链合规压力升级
focus.summary: 本周国际经贸领域呈现两条主线：一是美国联合盟友强化对先进计算与半导体设备的出口管制协同，并扩大实体清单适用范围，第三国转口风险上升；二是欧盟碳边境调节机制过渡期临近尾声，钢铝、化工等产品出口商面临碳数据申报与成本传导压力。同时，多国重启贸易救济调查，关税工具化趋势明显。对中国出海企业而言，合规重心正从单一市场准入转向全链条供应链溯源与多法域协同应对，建议提前梳理高风险物项与转口路径。
focus.source: 来源：美国商务部、欧盟委员会及WTO贸易监测动态 · 本周
focus.title_en: Weekly Global Trade Agenda: Allied Export Controls and Tariff Instrumentalization Raise Supply-Chain Compliance Pressure
focus.summary_en: This week's international trade landscape is shaped by two trends. First, the United States and its allies have tightened coordinated export controls on advanced computing and semiconductor equipment, expanding entity-list coverage and raising third-country transshipment risks. Second, as the EU CBAM transitional period nears its end, exporters of steel, aluminium and chemicals face carbon-data reporting and cost pass-through pressure. Meanwhile, multiple jurisdictions have relaunched trade-remedy investigations, underscoring the instrumentalization of tariffs. For Chinese outbound enterprises, compliance focus is shifting from single-market access to full-chain traceability and multi-jurisdictional coordination; early mapping of high-risk items and transshipment routes is advised.
focus.source_en: Source: U.S. Department of Commerce, European Commission and WTO trade monitoring updates · this week

case.title: 本周案例观察：跨境仲裁中临时措施跨境执行获支持，凸显仲裁地选择与保全策略价值
case.summary: 本周一则跨境商事仲裁实践引发关注：某中国企业与境外交易对手因供货合同争议在新加坡仲裁，仲裁庭作出的临时保全措施随后在第三国法院获得承认与执行，有效防止了资产转移。该案要点在于仲裁地法律对临时措施的支持力度、纽约公约框架下的执行路径，以及申请人举证紧迫性与不可弥补损害的技巧。启示：出海企业应在合同中优选支持临时措施的仲裁地与规则，争议初期即评估全球资产保全，避免“赢了裁决、执行落空”。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC）案例实践与相关法院公开信息 · 本周
case.title_en: Weekly Case Watch: Cross-Border Enforcement of Interim Measures in Arbitration Affirmed, Highlighting Seat Selection and Preservation Strategy
case.summary_en: A cross-border commercial arbitration practice drew attention this week: in a supply-contract dispute between a Chinese company and an overseas counterparty seated in Singapore, interim preservative measures issued by the tribunal were subsequently recognized and enforced by a third-country court, effectively preventing asset dissipation. Key points include the seat jurisdiction's support for interim measures, enforcement pathways under the New York Convention framework, and techniques for demonstrating urgency and irreparable harm. Takeaway: outbound enterprises should select arbitration seats and rules supportive of interim relief and assess global asset preservation at the outset of disputes to avoid winning an award that cannot be enforced.
case.source_en: Source: SIAC case practice and publicly available court information · this week

policy.title: 本周政策综述：粤港澳大湾区跨境便利化再提速，数据出境与跨境结算规则持续优化
policy.summary: 本周中国涉外与跨境政策围绕大湾区展开：广东自贸试验区及横琴、前海、南沙等平台进一步简化跨境投融资与外债登记流程，推动跨境人民币结算便利化；数据出境安全评估与个人信息出境标准合同备案机制在部分行业推出更清晰的操作指引，便利企业开展跨境数据传输。同时，涉外法律服务领域鼓励粤港澳联营所与仲裁机构合作，提升跨境争议解决能力。总体看，政策在“便利化”与“安全可控”之间寻求平衡，出海企业应同步完善数据合规与跨境资金安排。
policy.source: 来源：广东省人民政府、国家网信办及大湾区相关平台发布 · 本周
policy.title_en: Weekly Policy Roundup: Greater Bay Area Cross-Border Facilitation Accelerates, Data Export and Cross-Border Settlement Rules Refined
policy.summary_en: This week's China-related cross-border policies centered on the Greater Bay Area. The Guangdong Pilot Free Trade Zone and platforms such as Hengqin, Qianhai and Nansha further simplified cross-border investment, financing and foreign-debt registration, promoting RMB cross-border settlement facilitation. Clearer operational guidelines for data export security assessment and standard-contract filing for personal information exports were introduced in certain sectors, easing cross-border data transfers. Meanwhile, the foreign-related legal services sector encouraged Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao joint ventures and arbitration institutions to cooperate in enhancing cross-border dispute resolution. Overall, policy balances facilitation with security and controllability; outbound enterprises should concurrently improve data compliance and cross-border fund arrangements.
policy.source_en: Source: Guangdong Provincial People's Government, Cyberspace Administration of China and Greater Bay Area platform releases · this week

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：供应链合规进入“多法域协同”阶段，出海企业应建立动态风险地图
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师周度研判：本周信号表明，出口管制、关税与数据规则正从单点监管走向多法域协同，企业面临的不是单一合规问题，而是供应链全链条的“合规叠加”。建议出海企业：一是建立覆盖物项、交易对手、转口路径的动态风险地图，按季度更新；二是在合同中嵌入出口管制与制裁合规条款、碳数据申报义务及临时措施保全安排；三是争议解决优先选择支持临时措施且执行便利的仲裁地。下周重点关注欧盟CBAM实施细则、美国实体清单更新及大湾区跨境数据流动试点进展。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师团队·律连全球iGlobal Law · 本周
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's Weekly View: Supply-Chain Compliance Enters Multi-Jurisdictional Coordination Phase; Outbound Firms Need Dynamic Risk Maps
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's weekly view: This week's signals indicate that export controls, tariffs and data rules are moving from single-point regulation toward multi-jurisdictional coordination, confronting enterprises not with isolated compliance issues but with layered compliance across the entire supply chain. Recommendations for outbound enterprises: first, build dynamic risk maps covering items, counterparties and transshipment routes, updated quarterly; second, embed export-control and sanctions compliance clauses, carbon-data reporting obligations and interim-measure preservation arrangements into contracts; third, prioritize arbitration seats that support interim measures and offer convenient enforcement. Next week, watch EU CBAM implementing rules, U.S. entity-list updates and Greater Bay Area cross-border data flow pilot progress.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao's team · iGlobal Law · this week
